title: Wire Office mail and NotNotes semantic ownership
summary: Wire renders webmail and NotNotes at Office, with ooRexx application truth and storage authority. MailReader uses bounded source windows and stable mailbox/UIDVALIDITY/UID identities, not 200,000 browser widgets.
invariants: Both apps are behind the Office mTLS gate before static assets or application routes.
Authoritative note revisions, ACL, links, conflict rules and intentions remain server-side.
The browser is a renderer, not a DOM-shaped application object authority.
A mailbox must be bounded/paged and scoped by account, mailbox, UIDVALIDITY and UID.

provenance.claim: Wire Office and NotNotes implementation assignment.
